x-summary: A NATO rank grade held from a given date.
title: RankHistory
description: Illustrative placeholder for NATO grade/rank history (APERSP-01 — NATO Codes for Grades of Military Personnel). The exact valid code set is NOT verified against the primary APERSP-01 text — `grade` is pattern-validated (OF-n / OR-n shape) rather than a closed enum, on purpose, to avoid presenting an unverified list as authoritative. Verify against the real standard before relying on this beyond illustration.

grade.x-help: NATO rank code: OR-1 to OR-9 for other ranks, OF-1 to OF-10 for officers, e.g. OF-3.
grade.description: NATO grade code shape (e.g. OF-3, OR-6, OF(D)) — not a verified closed set.

gradeTitle.description: National-language rank title for this grade (e.g. "Captain") — free text, since national titles for the same NATO grade vary by country.
